transport: Optional diagnostic_d2 extension, alongside unchanged D1 diagnostic.reason_code and phase
sqlstate: null unless the bounded exception chain contains an actual psycopg.Error with a five-character uppercase/digit state other than 00000; never from arbitrary error attributes
classification: Producer uses actual SQLAlchemy/psycopg exception classes; never publishes __str__, SQL, parameters, traceback or environment.

status_contract.PASS: Never emitted by fixture; reserved for complete existing E2E checks.

malformed_or_contradictory: FAIL, DIAGNOSTIC_UNAVAILABLE or FIXTURE_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH; no mutation retry
historical_d1_compatibility: Original packet shape and parsing still accepted; five D1 seed test doubles cannot perform the newly mandatory operator helper.
